scientific_integrity: The statements derive from infinite-dimensional analytic proofs and the published rootless-tree criterion. Finite standard-library tests support computation of the weights and path ratios only; they do not certify the infinite theorem. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem holds for one explicitly constructed positive-weight rootless quasi-Brownian tree family and does not assert universal failure of Wold stability for all isometries or all directed trees. The analytic-series Wold criterion of Chavan and Trivedi is used as prior work. Schatten membership is exact for the difference from the specified isometry, and the sharp exponent two refers to that family. Possible broader independently published formulations remain a priority risk.
title: A sharp wandering-subspace transition inside vanishing Schatten perturbations of a rootless-tree isometry
